title: Volvo FH-FM Low profile hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #16
description: FH-FM series Volvo heavy duty FUPS hi-tensile low profile aluminium Bullbar. The low profile allows for the grill to be opened to carry out daily checks without dropping the Bullbar. Optional mesh over whole of bull bar & Road Train signs not shown. Mesh fitted in front of grill and roo-cutters in the front of the headlights for maximum protection. 76mm heavy wall tube. Indicator repeaters recessed into outer uprights. Heavy duty contoured lower skirt to main bar. Steel tow pin mounted in heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate.
